sources.title: Entropy Constraints on High Spin Particles

evidence.text: Estimate the Gaussian packet's energy using the one-particle Hamiltonian and relativistic dispersion. Momenta contributing appreciably satisfy |k| ≲ 1/R, giving an energy expectation M + O(1/(MR²)); compare the assigned spin entropy with the Bekenstein bound.

sources.title: Ultraviolet-infrared bounds and minimum coupling in effective field theories

evidence.text: Estimate the largest gauge potential energy resolvable within the cutoff as EΛ∼g²Λ. Apply ΔEΔt≳1 to obtain tΛ≳(g²Λ)⁻¹, associate this time with a length using Lorentz invariance, and combine the resulting condition with a UV–IR inequality.

sources.title: Effective field theory, black holes, and the cosmological constant

evidence.text: Estimate finite-UV and finite-volume corrections, then minimize their combined size subject to the proposed cutoff constraint. For coupling evolution, match S-matrices of theories with different allowed cutoff pairs in their common domain of validity.

sources.title: Entropy Constraints on High Spin Particles

evidence.text: For the gravitational comparison, estimate the Hawking-temperature variation parameter Ṫ/T² using polarization multiplicity, and independently estimate the minimum black-hole size capable of accommodating spin s using Kerr extremality.

sources.title: Ultraviolet-infrared bounds and minimum coupling in effective field theories

evidence.text: An appendix gives additional motivation from a Bohr radius RB(mf)∼(g²mf)⁻¹. Requiring the EFT to accommodate that bound state, RB≲L, together with mf≲Λ, yields the same necessary coupling–cutoff relation.

sources.title: Ultraviolet-infrared bounds and minimum coupling in effective field theories

evidence.text: Support the detection-time estimate using screened plasma scattering: soft relativistic scattering has timescale ∼(g²T)⁻¹, while screening prevents faster exchanges. Nonrelativistic scattering and gauge-boson scattering are argued not to beat tΛ when mf<Λ and nf≲mf³.
